title: Me, You, and Them
goal: Refer to yourself and other people in simple everyday sentences.

patterns.english: He is Carlo. / She is Carlo.
He is my friend. / She is my friend.

notes: Tagalog siya can mean either he or she.

objectives.description: Refer to yourself, another person, and a group of people.
Ask another person for their name.
Say that someone is your friend.
Introduce another person with a simple sentence.

scenarios.title: Introducing a friend
scenarios.setup: You are with a friend and meet someone new.
scenarios.learnerGoal: Introduce yourself and your friend, then ask the new person's name.

scenarios.title: Talking about a group
scenarios.setup: Someone asks who the people with you are.
scenarios.learnerGoal: Say that they are your friends.
